adjudication_protocol.conflict_rule: Preserve the higher-authority fact, mark the affected axis incomplete, and retain the conflict as a bounded diagnostic.
adjudication_protocol.counterexample_rule: Add or update an anonymous case before changing recognition; reproducible false positives remove or downgrade the old inference unless stronger structured evidence exists.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Turn completed after one durable exec operation.

adjudication.basis: Structured turn terminal record is authoritative for lifecycle.
adjudication.invalidates: Socket closure or terminal completion alone must not invent turn completion.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The upstream UI showed a phase that this version does not recognize.

adjudication.basis: An unknown semantic shape cannot be mapped to a known lifecycle by text similarity.
adjudication.invalidates: Remove any fallback that guesses lifecycle from unknown payload text.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI displayed an execution approval prompt.

adjudication.basis: Typed approval request is direct attention evidence.
adjudication.invalidates: Generic tool-running records do not imply an approval prompt.

cases.codex_ui_observation: An unresolved prompt existed before the retained rollout tail.

adjudication.basis: Missing pre-tail history cannot prove that attention is absent.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not publish attention NONE as complete after a cold-start gap without a clear baseline.

cases.codex_ui_observation: One background process was shown for the matching invocation.

adjudication.basis: Protocol process identity confirms the association.
adjudication.invalidates: Display call IDs are not sufficient when process identity conflicts.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The durable record had a call ID but no rollout generation or process identity.

adjudication.basis: A reused call ID without process or rollout scope cannot prove ownership.
adjudication.invalidates: Never upgrade call-id-only correlation to confirmed association.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Codex remained visible while current observer probes failed.

adjudication.basis: A failed current probe is direct evidence about observer quality.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not hide probe failure behind an unchanged workload lifecycle.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Codex produced no new semantic event, but all observer probes completed.

adjudication.basis: Workload silence is distinct from observer scheduling or collector failure.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not infer observer degradation solely from lack of Codex events.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Codex was still visible, while observer probes were stale or unavailable.

adjudication.basis: Probe failure is observer state and does not prove workload silence or network health.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not convert missing socket/process evidence into IDLE, CLOSED, or healthy conclusions.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI remained in a long reasoning phase while network counters still advanced.

adjudication.basis: Recent supporting activity prevents a stall conclusion.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not classify long model reasoning as stalled from elapsed time alone.

cases.codex_ui_observation: A long tool remained alive and showed process activity.

adjudication.basis: Process-tree progress is current evidence even when tool output is quiet.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not use a fixed tool duration as proof of a stall.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Rollout did not grow, while a child process continued to perform work.

adjudication.basis: A newer process observation outranks absence of rollout growth.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not equate a quiet rollout with a quiet workload.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The turn had already completed and the launcher process was still present.

adjudication.basis: A structured turn terminal record ends active silence assessment.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not keep stall state alive solely because a process remains.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI remained generating and two full samples found no activity on any observed source.

adjudication.basis: Two complete quiet windows past the phase threshold support a suspicious stall.
adjudication.invalidates: A single old event is insufficient; require repeated current observations.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The same generating phase stayed quiet beyond the severe threshold.

adjudication.basis: Prolonged silence after repeated complete probes raises severity without inventing failure.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not label severe silence as a terminal failure.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI still showed work, but the process collector was stale.

adjudication.basis: Collector staleness describes observer quality rather than workload state.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not publish quiet, stalled, or healthy workload conclusions from blind probes.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Observed historical phases commonly remained quiet this long.

adjudication.basis: A reviewed historical p95 raises the suspicious threshold.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not ignore a sufficient local silence baseline.

cases.codex_ui_observation: One connection was idle while another connection for the same process received data.

adjudication.basis: Any current active routed flow keeps the process aggregate active.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not let one idle flow overwrite another active flow.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The request had no new payload bytes but TCP acknowledgements advanced.

adjudication.basis: ACK delta is transport progress even when send and receive byte counters are unchanged.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not classify an ACK-progress window as idle or stalled.

cases.codex_ui_observation: One sample showed a retransmission with no higher-level failure.

adjudication.basis: One abnormal transport window supports suspicion, not a confirmed stall.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not promote a single retransmit delta directly to STALLED.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The routed connection disappeared between complete socket samples.

adjudication.basis: A complete before/after transition supports transport closure.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not claim an active socket after a verified close.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The Codex UI showed a completed turn after its TCP connection closed.

adjudication.basis: Structured lifecycle remains authoritative over supporting socket state.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not convert socket CLOSED into TURN_FAILED.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Only the first abnormal transport window had been observed.

adjudication.basis: The confirmation rule requires two consecutive abnormal windows.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not confirm a stall from one window.

cases.codex_ui_observation: A second consecutive abnormal window arrived without protocol progress.

adjudication.basis: Two consecutive suspect windows satisfy the transport-stall support rule.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not reset consecutive abnormal evidence without progress.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The socket metric looked abnormal while Codex emitted fresh protocol progress.

adjudication.basis: Fresh authoritative progress clears the supporting stall window.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not let socket suspicion override current semantic progress.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Two Codex instances used different home pairs.

adjudication.basis: The full CODEX_HOME and SQLite-home pair defines instance identity.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not merge instances by workspace or executable name.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Two sessions shared one instance and workspace.

adjudication.basis: Session/thread identity remains distinct inside the same instance.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not merge sessions solely because workspace and home match.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The kernel reused a PID after the earlier process exited.

adjudication.basis: Kernel start time scopes process identity across PID reuse.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not reuse caches keyed only by PID.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The process list showed the Node launcher for Codex.

adjudication.basis: The executable path contains the confirmed Codex launcher form.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not require comm to equal codex for a known launcher wrapper.

cases.codex_ui_observation: A renamed process exposed the structured app-server invocation.

adjudication.basis: The bounded command line provides a Codex token and app-server role.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not reject a renamed app-server based on comm alone.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Environment and an open rollout descriptor identified different homes.

adjudication.basis: Conflicting direct sources remain visible and unresolved.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not choose whichever home is easier to display.

cases.codex_ui_observation: No TTY, tmux, VS Code, or SSH clue was observable.

adjudication.basis: PID and cwd help manual correlation but do not identify a terminal.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not invent terminal ownership from workspace proximity.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI reconnected and then resumed model output.

adjudication.basis: Fresh semantic progress closes a pending reconnect episode.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not leave recovery stuck at RECONNECTING after progress.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI fell back to another transport and resumed output.

adjudication.basis: Progress after fallback is direct recovery evidence.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not report fallback as an unresolved failure after resumed progress.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI was actively reconnecting and had not resumed.

adjudication.basis: The latest typed recovery edge is still open.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not infer recovery before a progress or explicit recovered edge.

cases.codex_ui_observation: A newer turn was generating after an older turn failure.

adjudication.basis: A later turn baseline prevents an old failure from becoming current.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not resurrect historical failure across a newer turn.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The reconnect attempt ended in a typed turn failure.

adjudication.basis: A terminal failure closes the pending recovery state.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not continue displaying RECONNECTING after terminal failure.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI requested filesystem permission.

adjudication.basis: The typed permission request is direct attention evidence.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not collapse permission into generic user input.

cases.codex_ui_observation: An MCP server displayed an elicitation form.

adjudication.basis: The typed MCP elicitation preserves its interaction class.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not report all external prompts as approval.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI requested authentication input.

adjudication.basis: The typed authentication edge requires direct interaction.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not confuse authentication with a transport failure.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI continued generating after the earlier question was answered.

adjudication.basis: Later progress is a trusted resolution baseline for prior attention.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not keep resolved user input in the attention queue.

cases.codex_ui_observation: A delayed duplicate approval record arrived after the tool had started.

adjudication.basis: Event-time ordering keeps the later progress baseline authoritative.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not revive cleared attention from a late older record.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI was generating after attachment began in the middle of an active turn.

adjudication.basis: Typed model progress is a current phase baseline even when TURN_STARTED predates the retained tail.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not leave lifecycle unknown solely because the retained stream begins after TURN_STARTED.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI showed an active tool after attachment began in the middle of the invocation.

adjudication.basis: Typed tool progress establishes the running-tool phase without requiring an earlier turn baseline.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not downgrade a typed active tool to unknown when its TURN_STARTED record is outside lookback.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI remained in compaction while a keepalive arrived.

adjudication.basis: Compaction remains authoritative until a typed completion or terminal turn event.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not let non-phase keepalive traffic end an active compaction phase.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI resumed generation after compaction completed.

adjudication.basis: A typed compaction completion closes COMPACTING and restores the active model phase.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not leave lifecycle stuck in COMPACTING after its completion edge.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI continued generating when a later keepalive arrived.

adjudication.basis: Keepalive is freshness evidence and does not supersede the latest phase-bearing protocol event.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not translate a recent keepalive into waiting or completed lifecycle.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI still showed the tool running after a model configuration record arrived.

adjudication.basis: Model configuration updates metadata and cannot replace a typed tool phase.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not derive lifecycle from the newest record regardless of record authority.

cases.codex_ui_observation: The UI was generating in a newer phase when an older completion record arrived late.

adjudication.basis: Event-time ordering keeps the newer phase-bearing progress authoritative over late historical completion.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not mark a current turn completed from a terminal event older than observed progress.

cases.codex_ui_observation: Two parallel background commands were visible as separate active operations.

adjudication.basis: Distinct protocol process identities preserve two independently confirmed terminal operations.
adjudication.invalidates: Do not collapse parallel calls into one terminal because their lifetimes overlap.
